command.syntax: agentsecctl gateway accept-agent --custody-file ABS --ca-bundle-file ABS [--timeout 1s..30s] < protected challenge envelope JSON
command.selection: Root selected accept-agent command spelling. Backend activation_and_UI old gateway association accept spelling must be aligned in merged contract before TDD; no aliases assumed.
command.input: One bounded<=4096 UTF8 strict3-key ChallengeEnvelope from stdin; no token material. Decode canonical RawURL challenge_wire<=4096 exact native canonical ASCII inner12; digest exact decodedbytes. Reject duplicate/null/unknown/alias/trailing/surrogate/invalidUTF/noncanonical hash/wire.
command.flags: Closed original duration grammar, default10s; absolute custody and CA paths; no endpoint/key/credential/Agent/nonce override, credential-output, automatic activate/revoke/reissue, or positional flags.
command.flow: Parse envelope; build existing direct HTTPS explicitCA TLS client; open original guarded enrollment Store; Store.BeginAssociation(envelope,now) durably prepares selected exact acceptance intent BEFORE HTTP; Source gives stored original endpoint and owned snapshot; sign fixed POST using Association.Sign; single live response read/strictparse/match; Confirm(response,completeResponseNow) durably persists receipt; check context again before success; close Association/client then Store on every path.
command.expiry_context: Require challenge and protected original credential future at Begin/send and AFTER complete response. Native server enforces actual current credential validity, Agent source availability, challenge issuance TTL/replay/nonce and same-scope generation. Checkctx after HTTP read and after Confirm filesystem IO before success. No automatic receipt-success response from saved historical Receipt.
command.transport: Original source HTTPS origin, Proxy:nil directdial, standard hostname/IP SAN verification +explicit CA,minTLS1.2,no redirects/no fallback. Fixed POST /internal/v1/runtime-gateway/agent-device-associations/accept; Content-Type/Accept application/json; Cache-Control:no-store. Exactly200,single exact Content-Type application/json,single Cache-Control no-store,boundedresponse,context live.
command.report: Nonsecret state device_acceptance_recorded, outcome confirmed for this phase2 persisted receipt, association_activation pending_human, challenge_id/association_id/agent_id/device_id/credential_id/generation and replayed presentation as useful. On any refused/ambiguous invocation generic error +device_acceptance_unknown/outcome unknown. NEVER state active/admitted/healthy/covered; never confirm original enrollment outcome. No nonce/raw challenge/raw response/key/token/proof/header or raw filesystem/network error reflection.

inner.choice: Native authoritative deterministic ASCII byte builder; no separate preparation transaction, no Go-vs-JSONB rehash equivalence.
inner.encoding: UTF8 JSON, no whitespace, keys exactly above, string values canonical ASCII product IDs/lowerhex digest/RawURL32nonce/wholeUTC expiry. expected version canonical decimal integer. All variable scalar alphabets validated before SQL concatenation; no arbitrary source names in raw challenge.
inner.challenge_wire: CanonicalRawURL of EXACT original bounded bytea, <=4096 decoded bytes. ChallengeSHA256 lowerhex64 of exact bytea. Persist immutable original bytes and nonce hash; no reserialize/restamp. Go parser has matching fixed struct order for verification only; never replaces stored bytes.
inner.non_authorizing: Nonce/challenge are NONAUTHORIZING public challenge material. Key possession signature plus separate fresh human finalization required. Storing/echoing exact challenge is allowed; nonce alone grants nothing. Human/device credentials and private keys never stored.
inner.accept_body: Exact3keys schema,challenge_wire,challenge_sha256. Strict UTF8/JSON duplicate/null/unknown/casealias/trailing/surrogate refusal. Existing HTTP signature binds exact outer body and current credential/method/host/path/query/time. Control SQL validates decoded raw challenge exactly equals private pending row bytea and nonce hash, not just a caller hash.

accept_request.binding: Keep exact original challenge_wire/hash from envelope. Build canonical outer rawbody once; store bytes and retry IDENTICAL rawbody. Native SQL compares decoded raw challenge to immutable private challenge bytea+nonce hash, not just digest.

response.contract: Current exactsamecredential rawrequest replay stable BEFOREexpiry; superseded/expired/revoked/rotated candidate denied. No accepted response implies active association.

acceptance.expires_at: min(original challenge expiry,currentcredential expiry), never extended on replay

wire.response_match: Exact challenge_id/hash/association_id from decoded original challenge; acceptance.request_sha256 == SHA256(exact retained POST rawbody); credential exact retained credentialID+generation+originalexpiry. accepted_at canonicalUTC<=6fraction and <=actual complete-response now; acceptance.expires_at=min(challengeexpiry,credentialexpiry)>now. Original accepted_at stable on replay may precede retry sendtime. Original human fresh author proof is NOT in response and NOT inferred.
wire.signing: Exact existing zasp-runtime-gateway-request-v1 canonical method/authority/path/credential/timestamp/exactRawBodySHA, ZaspGatewayV1 originalcredential, retained originalpublickey selfverification before headers. Fresh wholeUTC timestamp/signature per retry, no frozenbody restamping. Fixedpath/no query/userinfo/rawpath/redirect. Existing enrollment/Authority signers unchanged.
wire.types: Challenge exact12; ChallengeEnvelope exact3; AcceptResponse exact5,nested Acceptance4/DeviceCredential3. DeviceBinding carries original org/work/env/device/credentialID/gen/publickey/expiry from protected custody; private key never exposed. Exact final names may be aligned jointly before scaffolds, never after baseline silently.
